scenarios.prompt: Add a new published module `skainet-io:skainet-io-newformat` that depends on `skainet-io:skainet-io-core` and uses kotlinx-io for stream handling. Provide the full set of edits.
scenarios.must_not_contain_reason: Hard rule 1: every coordinate routes through the catalog; hard rule 4: Dokka is configured by sk.ainet.dokka, not applied directly. New modules get targets/explicitApi/kotlin-test from the sk.ainet.multiplatform convention plugin and need a per-module gradle.properties with POM_ARTIFACT_ID/POM_NAME.
Catalog entries already encode versions; module scripts only refer to aliases. Kotest lives only in the skainet-apps CLI tests — library modules use kotlin.test.

scenarios.prompt: I just added skainet-io:skainet-io-newformat. What else changes for it to be a properly published artifact?
scenarios.must_not_contain_reason: BOM membership is automatic: the sk.ainet.transformers.bom-coverage convention plugin constrains every module that applies the publish plugin — hand-editing skainet-bom is the pre-0.57.0 workflow.

scenarios.prompt: Configure the Android target with JVM 17.
scenarios.must_not_contain_reason: Android compilations of KMP modules stay at JVM 11 (JVM targets build Java 21 bytecode, set centrally in the root build); per-module deviation only via skainet { androidJvmTarget }.
